newsitem.title: UK: George Wimpey sees strong 1997 results.
newsitem.headline: George Wimpey sees strong 1997 results.

text.p: British homebuilder George Wimpey Plc, posting a sharp rise in 1996 profits, said on Tuesday it expected to have a significantly stronger financial performance this year.

"We have a target of achieving and sustaining a return on capital within a range of 15-20 percent, which I believe is realistic and attainable for all our trading businesses," chairman Joe Dwyer said in a statement.
The company's 1996 pretax profits jumped to 31.5 million stg from 15.6 million stg the previous year.

"The results for 1996 show a major improvement on the previous year. However, the trends in the second half of the year indicate that we can look forward to a significant strengthening of our financial performance in 1997," Dwyer said.
